title: Only 222 People Have Actually Been Frozen
hook: Nearly 1,927 signed up, but only 222 are frozen.
closing: Members are paying today for a future revival science still cannot deliver.
question: Would you pay for cryonics?

segments.say: Alcor has frozen 222 people so far, and that group grows only after members die.
About 1,927 people signed up, but most remain alive and waiting rather than frozen.
Freezing a whole body costs $200,000, so many members fund the bet through life insurance.
